execution.trigger: Integer division truncation in token redistribution.
execution.state_issue: Truncation leads to loss of tokens due to integer division discarding fractional parts.
execution.exploitable_behavior: The contract allows for a permanent loss of coins when redistributing tokens or ether.

causality.state: Integer division truncation in token redistribution calculations.
causality.guard: No guard against the issue; calculations are performed as is.
causality.transition: Truncation occurs during redistribution without adjustment for remainders.
causality.capability: An attacker can exploit this by causing a remainder, leading to loss of tokens.
causality.outcome: Permanent loss of coins in the bank address.
